page.overview:
Who is Leatherhead?

In the console version of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3: Mutant Nightmare, Leatherhead is shown in the background in a cutscene near the end of Episode 1.

There is no reason given why he is there in space with the Turtles, , and , as he was not shown to have accompanied them to space. However, this is because the scene was taken directly from the cartoon, where he was with them for some time.

However, he does appear in the DS version of the game as a boss fight and in a level or two where he teams up with the TMNT. Category:Crocodilians Category:Mutants (2003 video games) Category:Friends and allies (2003 video games) Category:Battle Nexus contestants

Also known as: Leatherhead alligator.
